name: Skip Prologue
description: On a brand-new save, skips the "Once upon a time..." stork prologue (game modes $37/$38/$39) and drops straight into the Welcome To Yoshi's Island level, exactly where the prologue would have ended. Mutually exclusive with "Skip Prologue and Welcome Level" - enable only one.
details: The new-game branch (CODE_179932, Bank17 $17:9932) defaults to gm$1F (-> overworld) then, when the per-save progress byte $1123,x is 0, overrides to gm$37 (prologue fade) at $17:9953 with the 8 bytes 'LDA #$37 : STA $0118 : STZ $0383'.

This chunk rewrites those 8 bytes in place (label CODE_179932 + $21) to 'LDA #$0B : STA $0118 : STA $021A' - the exact exit sequence the prologue itself runs at CODE_04E1A8 when the stork lands: gm$0B (fade -> gm$0C level load) with CurrentLevelFromMap = $0B (Welcome To Yoshi's Island). The fade direction ($0201=1) is already armed two instructions earlier, and the RTS at $17:995B is preserved.
The dropped 'STZ CurrentYoshiColor ($0383)' is non-essential: a fresh save's RAM mirror is zeroed (green), and the returning-save path never runs it either.

The 8-byte form only fits because game mode $0B and the Welcome map slot happen to share the value $0B (one LDA feeds both stores). Dropping into a different level would need 10 bytes (a second LDA) and a freespace stub - if Welcome is not wanted, use "Skip Prologue and Welcome Level" instead.
Byte layout verified against the built USA V1.0 cart (PC 0xB9953: A9 37 8D 18 01 9C 83 03). NEEDS in-game verification.
